pages.text: Arrange two pieces of Ice and Fire troll leather of any type and two troll tusks in a checkerboard to make two Troll Mixtures. Each mixture provides one unit of Troll Matter, a tier 2 Part Builder material.

Plating durability / armor: helmet 220 / 3, chestplate 320 / 7, leggings 300 / 5, boots 260 / 2. All four armor plates have 1 toughness and 5% knockback resistance. Shield plating has 320 durability, 2 toughness and 10% knockback resistance. Maille and shield cores have no extra stats.

Troll Matter works for all seven parts listed above. Shield plating costs 3 units and can be assembled with a valid shield core at the Tinker Station. Each Troll Matter part grants one level of $(l:trait_dark_denizen)Dark Denizen$().
